name: Tuomo Suntola
summary: Finnish physicist and inventor of Atomic Layer Epitaxy (ALE).

name: Riikka L. Puurunen
summary: Author of the essay and researcher at VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland.

name: Tampere
summary: City in Finland where Tuomo Suntola was born.

name: Finland
summary: Country where Tuomo Suntola lived and worked.

name: Helsinki University of Technology
summary: University where Tuomo Suntola studied and later worked.

name: VTT Semiconductor Laboratory
summary: Laboratory established in 1964 as part of Professor Thor Stubb's Electron Physics laboratory.

name: Vaisala Oy
summary: Finnish company specializing in meteorological instrumentation.

name: Instrumentarium Oy
summary: Company where Suntola established a research group in 1974.

name: Lohja Oy
summary: Building material company that acquired the ALE-EL project in 1978.

name: Planar Inc.
summary: American competitor that bought Lohja's EL business in 1990.

name: Beneq Oy
summary: Company that acquired Planar's EL plant in Olarinluoma in 2012.

name: Neste Oy
summary: National oil company that established Microchemistry Ltd.

name: Microchemistry Ltd.
summary: Company established in 1987 for ALE-based solar panels and later ALE reactors.

name: ASM
summary: Dutch company that bought Microchemistry in 1999.

name: Picosun Oy
summary: Company set up by Sven Lindfors in 2004, where Suntola joined in 2004.

name: Atomic Layer Epitaxy
summary: Thin film growth technique invented by Tuomo Suntola in 1974.

name: Humicap 1 sensor
summary: Humidity sensor developed by Suntola and Antson by end of 1973.

name: European SEMI Award 2004
summary: Award honoring the Pioneer in Atomic Layer Deposition Techniques.

name: Thor Stubb
summary: Professor at HUT who supervised Suntola's doctoral thesis.

name: Jorma Antson
summary: Colleague who completed the humidity sensor development with Suntola.

name: Sven Lindfors
summary: Closest co-worker to Suntola in ALE reactor design since 1975.

name: Arto Pakkala
summary: Colleague involved in the successful ZnCl2/H2S process demonstration.

name: Lauri Niinistö
summary: Professor of inorganic and analytical chemistry at HUT, organized first ALE conference.

name: Jun-ichi Nishizawa
summary: Japanese professor who started ALE research in Japan after 1981.

name: Aleskovskii
summary: Soviet professor who initiated molecular layering technique in the 1960s.
